description: This file implements a ThunderJS module for WebSocket communication, including connection management, request handling, event listening, and plugin registration.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection with specified options, manages socket events, and handles connection lifecycle.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC request over WebSocket and manages request resolution and rejection.

methods.name: registerPlugin
methods.description: Registers a plugin with a given name and plugin object, extending the thunderJS object.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Registers an event listener with automatic disposal management.
